text: Two massive Category 1 climbs bookend a relentless seven-summit gauntlet that will shred any remaining freshness after nine days of racing—this is the stage where "rest day legs" either carry you through or betray you entirely. Pogačar has unfinished business here: two years ago he bonked spectacularly on Puy Mary and got outkicked by Vingegaard on Col de Pertus, and he'll be hunting redemption on identical terrain. Watch whether the GC leader's team can protect him through the early climbs or if rival trains sense vulnerability and gang-tackle him on the accumulated fatigue before that final, deceptively short Col de Pertus descent—the same finish that burned Pogačar last time.
